method.observation: Retain one chronological material path, advect it with the actual head transform and hand displacement, then apply only small local skin contact corrections. Preserve endpoints, certify every final segment at6.5mm, reject a local correction over40mm, protect all unrelated action keys, and read the entire animation back. This is authored flexible tack, not a rope simulation. Inspect actual worst-change frames and intended/reverse views before any continuous handoff.
method.comparison: Specific source evidence can disprove geometry assumptions; fixed local implementation only.

strongest_counterexample: Even a conservative static clearance test can produce changing path topology or a visibly unnatural curve across frames. Actual whole path, hand/ring endpoints and intended/reverse views must falsify it; full-speed AV remains pending.
